title: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 1995

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 1995
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT III OF 1996
ACT III OF 1996
SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1995
An Act to amend the Sindh Boards
of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd January, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-22/95.----The
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Bill, 1995
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 17th December, 1995
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 9th January, 1996 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Act, 1995.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 1995
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972

ACT III OF 1996
ACT III OF 1996
SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1995
An Act to amend the Sindh Boards
of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd January, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-22/95.----The
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Bill, 1995
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 17th December, 1995
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 9th January, 1996 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 2 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972.---In the
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and 'Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972,
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 2, in clause (u), for
the words "Board at Sukkur", the words "Boards at Sukkur and
Larkana" shall be substituted.

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education Amendment Act 1995
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972

ACT III OF 1996
ACT III OF 1996
SINDH BOARDS OF INTERMEDIATE AND SECONDARY EDUCATION (AMENDMENT) ACT,
1995
An Act to amend the Sindh Boards
of Intermediate and Secondary Education Ordinance, 1972
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd January, 1996]
No. PAS/Legis-B-22/95.----The
Sindh Boards of Intermediate and Secondary Education (Amendment) Bill, 1995
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 17th December, 1995
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 9th January, 1996 is hereby
published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
3. Amendment of section 3 of Sindh Ordinance VI of 1972.---In the
said Ordinance, in section 3, in subsection (1):--
(i) in clause (b), the word
"and" occurring at the end shall be deleted;
(ii) in clause (c), the full stop
occurring at the end shall be replaced by a semicolon and the word
"and";
(iii) after clause (c) the
following clause (d) shall be added:---
"(d) at
Larkana, a Board called the Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education
Larkana. "
